description: Answers an invitation on the connected account's calendar: accepted, declined or tentative, with an optional note to the organizer. Takes the event ID and the response. The account has to be on the event's guest list; an event it is not invited to is refused with a message saying so. Returns the event ID, its title, the response now recorded and the note. With send_updates left at its default the organizer is told, as when a person answers in Google Calendar.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

comment.description: An optional note to the organizer, shown beside the answer.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to answer, as calendar_list_events and calendar_get_event return it.

response.description: The answer to record: accepted, declined or tentative.

send_updates.description: Who to send response notifications to (default: "all")

name: gws-mcp__calendar_respond_to_event
